title: Generative AI on AWS: Amazon Q and Bedrock

kcs.statement: Amazon Bedrock is a fully managed, serverless service that gives API access to foundation models from Amazon and third-party providers to build generative AI applications without managing infrastructure.
Amazon Q is a generative AI assistant: Amazon Q Business answers questions and creates content from a company's own data, and Amazon Q Developer helps write code and work with AWS resources.
To embed a foundation model in your own application use Bedrock; to give employees or developers a ready-made AI assistant use Amazon Q; to train your own model use SageMaker AI.

problem_ideas: A developer wants help writing a Lambda function and explaining an AWS error: which service?
A product team wants to add text summarisation to their app using a third-party model via API: Bedrock or SageMaker AI?
Employees want to ask questions of internal wikis and tickets in plain language: which Amazon Q offering?
Spot the distractor: 'Bedrock requires you to provision GPU EC2 instances.'
Classify four scenarios as Bedrock, Amazon Q, SageMaker AI or a managed AI service.
Explain in one sentence what a foundation model is to a non-technical manager.
